description: Cold-email campaigns via Smartlead: list and create campaigns, read campaign analytics, import leads, and inspect sending mailboxes.
data_handling: Reads campaign metadata, aggregate analytics, and mailbox health from the tenant's Smartlead account; writes campaigns and lead records (names, emails, companies — PII) that the tenant supplies for outreach.

operations.name: campaigns.list
operations.description: List all email campaigns for the connected Smartlead account (id, name, status, schedule).

operations.name: campaign.create
operations.description: Create a new (empty) email campaign. Returns Smartlead's raw create-campaign response ({ ok, id, name }). Configure sequence/schedule separately.

operations.name: campaign.analytics
operations.description: Fetch a campaign's aggregate analytics (sent, opens, replies, bounces, etc.) by campaign id.

operations.name: leads.add
operations.description: Import leads into a campaign (max 400 per request). Each lead needs an email; other fields and custom_fields feed the template merge tags. Idempotent: Smartlead de-dupes leads already in the campaign.

operations.name: email-accounts.list
operations.description: List the sending email accounts (mailboxes) connected to the Smartlead account, with warmup + health status.
